data.name: Dorris
data.gender_notes: Dorris is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word doron, meaning a gift or reward. In the biblical context, Doris is a feminine form of Doron, which symbolizes the gift of God's grace, kindness, and divine protection. The name Dorris carries the meaning “Dew” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dorris usually hope their child will grow to embody dew and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine grace and protection received from God.
data.etymology: Dorris belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dew.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dorris total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: דוריס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דוריס הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'מתנה של אלוהים' או 'אוצר רוחני'. השם דוריס נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'דωρίς' (Dorís), שפירושה 'מתנה' או 'אוצר'. בקשר לנצרות, השם דוריס מייצג את הרעיון של מתנה אלוהית או אוצר רוחני שמעניק אלוהים לאנושות.

in_greek.name: Δωρίς
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Δωρίς προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'δωρίς' (dorís), που σημαίνει 'δωρο' ή 'δώρο'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Δωρίς συνδέεται με την έννοια του δώρου του Θεού. Ο δωρο του Θεού αντιπροσωπεύει την πνευματική αξία και την αγάπη που προσφέρει ο Θεός στην ανθρωπότητα.

in_latin.name: Dorris
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Dorris originem in lingua Graeca habet, significans 'donum Dei' vel 'thesaurus spiritualis'. In traditione christiana, nomen Dorris refert ad ideam doni divini seu thesauri spiritualis, quem Deus hominibus concedit. Hoc nomen etiam connotationem habet spiritualem, significans gratiam et charitatem Dei.

in_english.name: Dorris
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dorris originates from the Greek word 'Δωρίς' (Dorís), meaning 'gift' or 'treasure'. In Christian tradition, Dorris represents the concept of a divine gift or spiritual treasure bestowed by God upon humanity. The name conveys a sense of spiritual significance, implying a connection to God's grace and charity. Historically, the name Dorris has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing the preciousness and value of spiritual gifts.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dorris, although an uncommon name in the English-speaking world, can be traced back to Greek origins. It brings to mind the concept of a gift, suggesting generosity, kindness, and the pleasure of receiving. In a broader cultural context, it represents the value of giving and receiving, which can be seen in various aspects of life, from personal relationships to societal structures.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, the name Dorris carries deeper meaning. As a name of Greek origin that symbolizes a gift or a reward, it can be linked to the divine blessings that come from God. In Christian theology, we believe that gift-giving, whether to others or to God, is a sacred act that strengthens bonds and demonstrates love, compassion, and gratitude. Moreover, the name Dorris can serve as a reminder of the greatest gift God has given us: His Son, Jesus Christ, who offers salvation and eternal life to all believers.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dorris, meaning "gift of the sea" in old Celtic, symbolizes the divine providence and the nurturing, healing power of the waters in our lives. It is a name that evokes a sense of mystery, transformation, and renewal.

historical_references.reference: The name Dorris has been used throughout Christian history by saints, scholars, and faithful believers who exemplified its meaning.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Dorris remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Elizabeth Dorris in Jerusalem, Israel credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Dorris, which means "Dew". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
